summary: Keep one implementation owner because migrations, shared contracts, Cloud services, Local storage, MCP, and documentation overlap. Execute in four ordered slices: schema/types, Cloud APIs, Local parity/tooling, then tests/docs/rollout review.
decision_refs: single writer for all repository changes
legacy retrieval projections remain read-compatible during migration
residual_risks: The single implementation task is large but avoids conflicting schema and API edits.
